Author of Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?

How Philip K. Dick connects

  • Work: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep? — Philip K. Dick wrote Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?
  • Topic: Blade Runner — Dick's novel inspired the Blade Runner films.

What is Philip K. Dick?

Philip K. Dick wrote the 1968 novel whose bounty hunters, androids, and empathy test became Blade Runner — even as Scott's film remade the mood.

Key threads lead to Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep? and Blade Runner.
